The same two command blocks in this card's body are ready to paste; raw output + the ref they ran at is all that's needed here. No re-derivation required on our side — the unlock discipline (re-verify on posted refs) is the requesting seat's job.

## Reading (a) — #11122（introspection 契约修复,Option B）

```text
$ git grep -nE 'IntrospectedTable|IntrospectedColumn|introspectSchema' origin/main -- '*.ts' '*.tsx' '*.mts' | grep -v '\.test\.' | grep -v '\.spec\.'
(零命中,exit 1)

$ git grep -nE '\.indexes\b' origin/main -- '*.ts' | grep -v '\.test\.' | grep -v '\.spec\.' | grep -iE 'introspect|schema.?diff|warehouse'
(零命中,exit 1)

$ git grep -n "from '@objectstack/spec" origin/main -- '*.ts' | grep -cv '\.test\.'
293
```

**PRIMARY 空、SECONDARY 空、CONTROL 293 > 0 ⇒ 零命中经确定存在的邻近词反查成立:cloud 腿干净,#11122 可落地。**

## Reading (b) — #11166（`SchemaDiffEntry` 增 "unreachable" kind,Option A）

```text

(零命中,exit 1)
```

**零命中且同一 CONTROL(293)通过 ⇒ cloud 无既有 posture 可破坏,#11166 的 cloud 腿消费者测量义务已满足。**

与卡内命令的差异说明(只影响形式,不影响语义):原命令为工作树 `grep -r` + 排除 `node_modules`/`/dist/`;此处用 `git grep <ref>` 直读 `origin/main`,tracked 树天然不含 node_modules/dist,`--include` 对应转成 pathspec。

按卡尾流程:两读数已贴,本卡关闭 —— #11122 / #11166 的落地闸释放(其席位按标准解锁纪律在所贴 ref 上复验)。
